Setting: Security Info Registration Reachable With Only A Temporary Access Pass
Recommendation: An enabled Conditional Access policy targeting the 'Register security information' user action (urn:user:registersecurityinfo) currently requires an authentication strength that a Temporary Access Pass does not satisfy. Any user with no phishing-resistant method yet - including anyone caught up in Microsoft's automatic passkey registration nudges starting 2026-09-01 for SMS/Voice users - relies on a TAP as their only way to bootstrap into registering a stronger method. If the policy gating that registration page itself demands a phishing-resistant strength with no TAP escape, that user can never reach the page that would let them register one, and is locked out of self-service recovery. Either add Temporary Access Pass (temporaryAccessPassOneTime/temporaryAccessPassMultiUse) to the authentication strength's allowed combinations, exclude this policy from targeting security info registration, or ensure every affected user has another bootstrap route (e.g. self-service FIDO2 registration) before relying on TAP.
